tasks.short: Compile, administer and grade psychology examinations.

steps.what: Compile the examination and approve its final questions, rubric and delivery settings
Release the approved examination to the enrolled cohort
Administer the examination and handle accommodations or disruptions
Calculate provisional closed-question scores using the approved answer key
Grade open answers and review anomalous closed-question results
Check the complete grade sheet and approve each final result
Commit approved results to the authoritative student record
Publish the approved results to the corresponding students

tasks.design: Configure the existing {LMS} item bank, closed-question scoring and {OTHER} grade transfer before writing code. Keep question validity, open answers, incident handling and every final result with the examiner. Release of questions, recording results and student publication are separate version-bound actions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Psychological reasoning in open answers and assessment validity need expert judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native item-bank scoring and grade transfer can remove actual repeated marking and entry of closed results.
tasks.still_hard: Ambiguous questions, accommodations, disciplinary reasoning and irregularities require human decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge reasoning fairly and recognise a defective question rather than treating the answer key as infallible.
tasks.altitude: Remove mechanical closed scoring and result entry while preserving examiner control.

evidence.claim: The digest describes Ans closed-question marking and item statistics.
The digest identifies a Brightspace-to-OSIRIS result-entry boundary at Radboud; it does not establish this institution's baseline.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for a mixed closed/open examination currently containing manual closed marking and result entry. No student effort or existing scoring runtime is credited. Validate the manual actions first.

s1 teacher supplies item_id, question_version, correct_response, points, learning_outcome, rubric_version, cohort_id, release_time and accommodation settings. Item validation/capture stays full time; absent reliable keys closed marking stays manual.

The LMS produces attempt_id, student_id, item_id and response; s4 uses deterministic scoring only. s5 resolves anomalies, s6 approves each final student_id/grade pair. No model grades or infers cheating.

a1 binds completed questions and audience/settings; a2 binds final grade sheet and record destination; a3 binds that same grade version and student visibility. Changes revoke relevant approvals. OTHER means the authoritative student information system; native integration preferred.
unknowns: Closed-answer share and current marking method
research_questions: Can an approved result be transferred and shown only to its corresponding student without duplicate entry?

incremental.description: Validate answer-key configuration and grade-transfer mapping changes

approvals.approved_version: s1 final examination version and cohort delivery settings
s6 final student grades and record destination
s6 final student grades and student visibility

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 5 release, 15 closed marking and 5 result record/publication hours less 2 upkeep = 23. Low has closed scoring and release already configured, leaving 5 transfer/publication hours minus 2 = 3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare psychology syllabi, assignments and handouts.

steps.what: Choose learning objectives, readings and psychologically appropriate teaching examples
Populate the syllabus calendar, reading list and standard course information
Draft assignments and explanatory handouts from the teacher's brief

loop.input: Teacher's objectives, examples, verified readings and syllabus skeleton
loop.output: Candidate assignments and handouts with source pointers
loop.check: Teacher solves each exercise and checks psychological claims, answerability, sensitive examples and source fidelity
loop.stop: Invented source or two unsuccessful revisions returns the affected item to manual authoring
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanatory examples and open exercises vary with the psychology topic; calendar data uses templates instead

steps.what: Test assignments and approve the complete accessible course materials
Publish approved syllabi, homework assignments and handouts to the course cohort

tasks.design: Use native {LMS}/{DOCS} syllabus templates for timetable and policy fields. Draft only the variable explanatory material with a source-scoped loop. The teacher solves and edits exercises and approves the whole accessible package before a separate course publication action.
tasks.previous_blocker: A usable psychology exercise must teach the intended concept without misleading claims or inappropriate personal disclosure.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates handle fixed course data and bounded drafting can offer topic-specific first versions.
tasks.still_hard: Pedagogical sequencing, scientific nuance and appropriate examples require a teacher.
tasks.human_edge: Anticipate how students may misunderstand a concept or experience a sensitive exercise.
tasks.altitude: Reduce mechanical syllabus preparation and first-draft prose.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: templates and source-scoped drafting can assist course materials; no local time saving is measured.

assumptions: All allocations are provisional. Assess actual manual syllabus population and publication before attributing savings; existing LMS copies do not earn a new benefit.

The teacher supplies outcome_id, reading_id, verified_source, example_constraints and exercise_goal in s1, retaining selection and capture labour. Course administration supplies date, session_id, policy_version and course_id. Missing fields are resolved manually in retained s1/s4 time.

s3 retained 18 hours includes correcting claims and exercises. s4 retains full final review and accessibility checks; copyrighted readings remain in authorised storage and only approved context enters drafting.

a1 binds final files, course_id, cohort and publication date after s4. Any content or audience change requires a new approval. No automatic student notification is added; such a send would require a separate action.
research_questions: Can students complete each generated exercise using the assigned reading without an unstated assumption?

already_counted.description: Read, solve and repair generated exercises

incremental.description: Maintain syllabus field mapping and source restrictions

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final material hashes and cohort publication settings

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central saves 15 template, 12 drafting and 5 publication hours minus 2 upkeep = 30. Low assumes template and publication already native, leaving 12 drafting minus 2 = 10.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research.

steps.what: Review the student's teaching, internship or research work
Supervise the student and discuss concerns, reasoning and next actions
Write and check the supervision record and student action note
Commit the approved supervision record
Send the approved action note to the supervised student

tasks.design: Keep observation, discussion and fresh supervision writing human. Configure the native {LMS} supervision form to save the completed approved record and send its separately approved student action note. Private supervisor observations are not copied into the student note.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision requires understanding the student's actual reasoning and professional conduct.
tasks.enabler_now: A native supervision form can route an already completed record and an audience-specific note without re-entry.
tasks.still_hard: Ethical concerns, research validity and difficult feedback cannot be resolved by record routing.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge a student's reasoning and support responsible professional development.
tasks.altitude: A small record-handling gain with supervision time preserved.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an LMS can route an approved supervision record and a separate student note using native forms.

assumptions: Shares are provisional for the teacher's supervision episode. Existing student effort is excluded; no claim is made that discussion or assessment shortens.

s3 teacher captures student_id, activity_id, date, observations, agreed_action, owner and due_date. Capture and confidentiality selection remain full time. No transcript or student-entered structured summary is assumed.

Native forms and message routing are tested first. a1 binds the complete private record and restricted destination; a2 binds the complete separate student note and recipient. Approval occurs in s3 after both final versions exist, as the teacher's ordinary final check.
If save/send already occurs without separate hands-on transfer, that benefit disappears. Missing IDs or unclear student-visible content returns to manual routing, not auto-inference.
unknowns: Actual record and note routing steps
research_questions: Can the native form send the action note without exposing private supervision observations?

incremental.description: Check routing and supervision-form permission changes

approvals.approved_version: s3 final private record and restricted destination
s3 final student action note and student recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central removes 3 record and 2 note-transfer hours, minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Low assumes 0.5 hour transfer saving offsets upkeep. If already fully native, keep the existing route and do not introduce this change.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recruit and hire new psychology faculty.

steps.what: Agree the faculty role criteria and draft the vacancy text
Approve the final vacancy text, criteria and publication channels
Publish the approved faculty vacancy
Evaluate applications against teaching and research criteria
Interview candidates and assess teaching demonstrations with the selection committee
Select the faculty recommendation and check its written rationale
Commit the approved hiring recommendation to the recruitment case
Prepare and approve the complete faculty offer and authorised terms
Send the approved faculty offer to the selected candidate
Accept or decline the faculty offer
Check accepted terms and approve the completed appointment record
Commit the approved faculty appointment

tasks.design: Configure {ATS} to publish an already approved vacancy and save an already checked recommendation. Keep application assessment, teaching demonstrations and faculty selection human. Include HR offer preparation, a separately gated offer send, candidate response, final appointment check and separate {HCM} commit without counting any of that labour as the teacher's saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hiring depends on academic judgement and the institution's appointment authority.
tasks.enabler_now: Native ATS publication and case-save actions can remove repeated manual handling after final approval.
tasks.still_hard: Teaching quality, research fit, fairness and appointment terms require accountable people.
tasks.human_edge: Assess academic work and deliberate with colleagues using job-relevant evidence.
tasks.altitude: A small administrative gain, with hiring decisions and candidate contact still human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native ATS workflows can publish approved vacancies and file approved selection recommendations without automated candidate ranking.

assumptions: Provisional shares include 85 teacher, 11 HR and 4 candidate units. Only the 85 teacher units enter focal savings; existing HR and candidate labour remains unchanged. Faculty interviewer time from other committee members is not counted as displaced teacher work.

s1 teacher supplies vacancy_id, role_criteria, approved_text and channels; s6 captures candidate_id, criterion_evidence, selection_rationale and committee decision. Writing and capture retain full time; native workflow is evaluated before custom software.
a1 binds final vacancy text and channels after s2; a2 binds final recommendation and recruitment case after s6. Edits invalidate approval. No model screens, ranks, rejects or infers candidate traits.

HR supplies salary, hours, start_date and appointment_authority in s8 and approves the complete offer before a3. s11 checks actual acceptance, effective_date and appointment fields before a4. Declines return to human selection; no appointment commits without acceptance.
Validate that publication and recommendation saving currently require separate manual actions. If already automated, retain the current route and claim no new savings.
unknowns: Current publication and record handling effort
research_questions: Which final vacancy and recommendation actions are genuinely performed by faculty rather than HR?

incremental.description: Check faculty workflow permissions and routing

approvals.approved_version: s2 final vacancy text and channels
s6 complete recommendation and recruitment case
s8 final offer terms and selected candidate recipient
s11 accepted terms and final appointment record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Teacher baseline 85: publication 5 plus record save 2 gives 7/85*100 minus 0.5 upkeep = 7.735%. High rounds down to 7.7. Low gets only 0.5 hour equivalent transfer benefit and offsets upkeep; already automated work retains its existing route.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep psychological teaching judgement and relationships central while reducing specific assessment and document-handling work.
reach: Help course teams build valid closed-question scoring and carefully reviewed teaching materials.
role.ambitious_version: A psychology teacher with more time for student reasoning and supervision, supported by reliable course and record workflows.
